# Kimpur

> Turkey's largest polyurethane systems producer with 281,000 ton capacity, serving global markets through regional subsidiaries and distribution partners.

Kimpur (Kimteks Poliüretan Sistemleri) is a leading polyurethane manufacturer established in 1988, operating production facilities and regional offices across Turkey, Europe, and North America. The company specializes in rigid and flexible foam systems, footwear technologies, and coating solutions for furniture, automotive, and industrial applications.

## Key Topics

- Polyurethane Systems
- KIMfoot® Footwear
- KIMrigid® Foam
- MDI Prepolimer
- Poliol
- Thermoplastic Polyurethane
- IATF 16949 Certification
- ISO 500
- Research & Development
- Regional Headquarters
- Distribution Network
- Sustainability
- Technical Support
- Product Innovation
- Manufacturing Capacity

## Global Operations & Regional Offices

- [Kimpur Europe](https://kimpur.com/tr/kimpur-europe): Kimpur Europe subsidiary in Latvia: manufacturing facility and European expansion
- [Kimpur Germany](https://kimpur.com/tr/kimpur-germany): Kimpur Germany GmbH Berlin headquarters for European commercial operations
- [Kimpur UK](https://kimpur.com/tr/kimpur-uk): Kimpur UK Limited London office strengthening UK and export market presence
- [Kimpur USA](https://kimpur.com/tr/kimpur-usa): Kimpur USA regional office in Franklin Park supporting North American market

## Product Lines & Business Partners

- [Jitpol Polyurethane](https://kimpur.com/tr/jitpol-poliuretan): Jitpol business partner: KIMrigid and KIMflex foam systems for furniture industry
- [Aknet Kimya](https://kimpur.com/tr/aknet-kimya): Aknet Kimya Gaziantep partner distributing KIMfoot footwear systems
- [ATG Industrial Technology](https://kimpur.com/tr/atg-endustriyel-teknoloji): ATG Industrial Technology partner for KIMspray and KIMcase coating systems
- [ERPA-Taçkim](https://kimpur.com/tr/erpa-tackim): ERPA-Taçkim Ankara partner for KIMrigid wood imitation decoration systems

## Research, Development & Technical Services

- [R&D Center](https://kimpur.com/tr/ar-ge-merkezi): Kimpur R&D Center: polyurethane technology research and product innovation
- [R&D Simulation Laboratory](https://kimpur.com/tr/arge-simulasyon-laboratuvari): Simulation lab for product testing, footwear production, and foam analysis
- [Technical Support](https://kimpur.com/tr/teknik-destek): Technical support team providing pre-sales and post-sales customer service
